Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The South Africa players are out in the middle. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam will open the innings for Pakistan. Bjorn Fortuin will start the proceedings for South Africa.

A top, top bowling display from Pakistan with the ball. At the start, the batters of South Africa were able to combat them, but once the second wicket of Malan fell, the batters just folded like a pack of cards. Haris Rauf and Faheem Ashraf conceded just 35 runs in their spell, and took 5 wickets to their name. Even Hasan Ali had 3 to his name but was slightly expensive. All in all, the mood will be very positive in the visitors' camp. It does look like this is Pakistan's game as they have been batting superbly and 145 needed does not seem like a big total to them. Will they chase this down easily? Join us shortly to find out.

They had a good stand brewing between Rassie van der Dussen and Janneman Malan as they raised 57 for the second wicket, but Malan could not continue. The next stand between Klaasen and Rassie too looked promising but when Klaasen lost his wicket, the wheels fell off, for the South Africans. They kept losing wickets in heaps and were not able to recover. The mood will be slightly damp in the South African camp.

A very sorry display with the bat by the hosts. They had the platform set at one point and could have really ended up with a big total to their name, but they imploded and let things spiral, which sees them end up with a low total of just 144.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Rauf ends the innings with his second wicket! Good length delivery on middle, Shamsi looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the keeper where Rizwan takes a comfortable catch. He appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Pakistan review it. Ultra Edge shows there is a spike when the ball passes the bat. SOUTH AFRICA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 144!
Review time! Is this caught behind? The Pakistani players sure think so. Ultra Edge shows a spike as the ball goes past the bat, will be out.
Full delivery on off, Shamsi hits it to mid off.
Full and outside off, Williams drives it through point for a run.
Full and outside off, Shamsi looks to drive but gets a bottom edge on this one.
Yorker on middle, Williams digs it out towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Yorker on off, Williams does well to dig it out.
OUT! CAUGHT! Afridi finally gets a wicket! Slower delivery on middle, Fortuin looks to go big but gets a top edge. It goes towards mid-wicket where Babar Azam takes a simple catch.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last man in for the hosts.
Short delivery on leg, Williams looks to pull but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Full delivery on off, Williams defends it towards the off side.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hasan Ali gets his third wicket! Slower delivery outside off, Magala lofts it over point but does not get the timing on it. It goes towards the fielder where Fakhar Zaman takes a good catch. There were two fielders converging, but in the end, Zaman does well to be the one to take the catch.
Lizaad Williams is the new batter in.
PLAY AND A MISS! Full and outside off, Magala looks to swing at it but misses it.
Good length delivery on middle, Magala plays it back towards the bowler.
SIX! That is smashed! Full delivery on off, Magala lofts it over long off for a maximum.

FOUR BYES! Length delivery outside off, Magala looks to go big but misses it. It goes towards the keeper where the ball bounces in front of Rizwan who fails to stop it. It goes towards third man for a boundary.
Short of a length on middle, Fortuin pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Short delivery on middle, Magala looks to pull but misses it. It goes safely towards the keeper.
Yorker on middle, Magala does well to dig it out.
Low full toss on middle, Fortuin hits it through covers for a single.
Full on middle, Magala flicks it uppishly towards square leg for a run.
Short delivery on off, Fortuin pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Full on middle, Fortuin pushes it towards mid off where Rauf misfields and concedes a boundary.
Low full toss on off, Fortuin pushes it towards mid on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rizwan takes an excellent catch! Good length delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to push but gets an outside edge. It goes towards the keeper where Rizwan dives to his left and takes an excellent catch. Two quick wickets fall and the visitors are closing the innings out very well.
Here's Bjorn Fortuin with the bat.
WIDE! Short delivery down the leg side, Phehlukwayo looks to pull but misses it. The keeper appeals for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head.
OUT! CAUGHT! Hasan Ali gets his first wicket! Length delivery on off, Mulder looks to go big but gets a top edge. It goes towards mid off where Babar Azam takes a comfortable catch.
Sisanda Magala is in now.
Full delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo drives it through covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mulder pushes it towards point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Length delivery on off, Mulder guides it to point.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new man in!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ashraf gets his third wicket! Full ball outside off, Linde looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards the keeper where Rizwan takes a comfortable catch behind the stumps.
Back of a length outside off, Mulder punches it through point for a single.
Short ball outside off, Linde punches it through point for a run.
Length delivery on leg, Mulder flicks it through square leg for a single.
Short delivery on off, Mulder punches it to point.
Length delivery on off, Mulder looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen get two runs.
Full delivery on middle, Mulder pushes it through mid on for a run.
Length delivery on off, Mulder pushes it to mid off.
Full delivery on off, Linde drives it towards mid off for a single.
The debutant, Wiaan Mulder is in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rauf gets the crucial wicket of Rassie van der Dussen! Full delivery on middle, van der Dussen lofts it over mid-wicket but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards the fielder where Mohammad Hafeez takes a comfortable catch.
Length delivery on off, Linde pushes it through point for a single.
Full on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on off, pushed through mid on for one.
George Linde is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Klaasen would be very disappointed as he thought that he was getting a biggie here, but he just finds the man in the deep with perfection. A shortish length ball around off, Heinrich Klaasen pulls this one, but does not do so cleanly and he holes out to Shaheen Afridi in the deep.
On off, on a length, pushed through mid on for a single. Fifty up for Rassie too! A quality innings this!
Shortish and outside off, Rassie van der Dussen lofts this one over point for a couple.
Around middle, pushed through mid on for a couple.
Review time! An appeal for lbw! Rassie van der Dussen is the man in question. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat. Ball Tracker shows that impact is outside leg. So Pakistan have just 1 review left.

NOT OUT! A wasted review, really. That looked like it would be missing but Azam decides to take the review, as the bowler seemed confident. Rassie positioned himself for that lap sweep but with some luck on his side, he gets a boundary. A full toss on middle and leg, Rassie van der Dussen looks to work this one to the leg side but he misses and the ball takes the body and goes to the fine leg fence. Review is taken, but the impact is outside. Will be a boundary.
Short on off, hooked to deep mid-wicket for one. A good over for Proteas as they collect 13 runs off this one.
SIX! A full toss and this is easy pickings for Rassie! A full toss on off, Rassie van der Dussen comes ahead and slams this one over deep mid-wicket.
Around off, back of a length, pulled to the deep mid-wicket region for one.
FOUR! CRACKED! A very good shot and Klaasen will want to play some more of these. A length ball, around off, Heinrich Klaasen spanks this one through covers. The ball reaches the ropes in a flash.
Another slower ball on off, HK bunts this one back to the bowler.
Leg bye. The off cutter on leg, RvdD looks to work this one to the leg side but he misses and the ball takes the pads and goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Hasan Ali is back on.

Around off, outside off, Heinrich Klaasen moves off side and looks to paddle this one to the leg side. But he notices that he will not be able to play the shot and opens up the face of the blade and guides it to the short third man fielder.
Fuller and just at the base of the off pole, Rassie digs this one out to the cover region for a quick single.
A good delivery, this. A slower delivery outside off, Rassie van der Dussen does not pick the ball as he just blindly swings the blade at this. Obviously, he misses this one.
Slightly behind the good length and outside the off pole, Heinrich Klaasen moves away and slaps this one to the fielder at sweeper cover. Only a single though.
Around off on a good length, Heinrich pushes this one to the cover region.
The physio is out in the middle for Faheem Ashraf. He seems to be fine to continue now.
A slower short ball around off, HK punches this one back to the bowler.
Floated delivery on middle, Klaasen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs from the over!
On middle, Rassie punches it towards long on for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Klaasen pushes it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! That is hammered! Floated delivery on middle, van der Dussen comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flighted delivery on off, van der Dussen looks to play the reverse sweep but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire denies it.
Back of a length on off, Klaasen punches it to point. A top over for Pakistan as they broke the stand which was looking dangerous.
Good length ball outside off, van der Dussen punches it through covers for a single.
Length delivery on off, Klaasen pushes it towards mid off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashraf gets his first wicket and it is also the big wicket of Malan! He played well in the previous game but he is not able to do so here. Full delivery outside off, Malan drives it uppishly towards covers where Fakhar Zaman takes a good catch to his left. An important breakthrough for the visitors.
Who comes out now? It is the skipper, Heinrich Klaasen who comes out now.
Full on off, van der Dussen pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Length delivery on off, Malan pushes it towards covers for a single.
Faheem Ashraf to have a go now!
Full and outside off, Malan pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Malan pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length delivery on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on off, Rassie looks to play an upper cut but misses it. It goes safely towards the keeper.
Slower delivery on middle, Malan pushes it towards the off side for a single.

Good length delivery on off, Malan looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards point. The batsmen take a single. The fielder goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it. It goes for overthrows. The batsmen take an extra run.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, van der Dussen looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary. They end the over with 2 boundaries now.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Loopy delivery on off, van der Dussen plays a reverse sweep uppishly over point for a boundary.
Floated delivery on middle, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball on off, van der Dussen pushes it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, van der Dussen plays a reverse sweep towards short third man.
Floated delivery on middle, Malan pushes it through mid on for a single.
Full on middle, Rassie flicks it through mid-wicket. Two runs taken. 17 runs from the over. SOUTH AFRICA ARE AT 53/1 AFTER THE POWERPLAY!
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, van der Dussen looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes wide of the keeper towards third man for a boundary. Slightly lucky but South Africa will not mind!
Short delivery on middle, Malan pulls it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Length ball on off, van der Dussen pushes it to covers.
FOUR! That is hammered! Full delivery on middle, van der Dussen lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Rassie makes good use of the Free Hit.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Short delivery on middle, van der Dussen pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. The third umpire calls it a no ball as Hasan Ali oversteps!
Full delivery on off, van der Dussen drives it towards covers for a single.
Change. Time for Hasan Ali to bowl now.
Full on middle, van der Dussen drives it to mid on.
Full and outside off, Malan drives it through covers for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Malan pushes it towards the leg side.
FOUR! That is smashed! Short delivery outside off, Malan comes down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Malan looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It lands safely towards covers.
Tossed up delivery on off, Rassie pushes it to covers.
On middle, van der Dussen keeps it out.
Bowling change. Haris Rauf has been introduced into the attack.
Loopy delivery on off, van der Dussen pushes it to covers.
Floated delivery on off, Malan pushes it towards covers for a quick single. Good running.
SIX! Nice use of the feet! Flighted delivery on middle, Malan comes down the track and lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Short delivery on off, Malan pushes it to covers.
Around off and middle, length ball, slogged away to deep square leg for one.
Around middle, slightly back of a length, JM works this one to the off side.
FOUR! A great stroke. A good length ball on middle, Janneman Malan goes to the leg side slightly and punches the ball through covers. The ball speeds away to the ropes.
Another length delivery around off, van der Dussen looks to block this one but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man for a single.
On a good length and on off, pushed to the point region for one.
Around off, on a length, pushed to the cover region.
Rassie van der Dussen is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Markram goes back now. He was in good form in the previous game but he ends his series, with the bat, not in the best way. A quicker delivery this time, slightly flatter too around middle and leg, Aiden Markram goes back and looks to flick this one off the back foot to the leg side but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. An appeal and the umpire agrees as he raises his finger. Markram has a quick chat with his partner and he opts to go for the review. Ultra Edge shows nothing and the Ball Tracker shows that this is umpire's call on wickets. Markram punches his bat, as he trudges back to the shed.
Review time! An appeal for lbw! Aiden Markram is the man in question. Ultra Edge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call.
On off, pushed through mid off for one more run.
Fuller and on middle and leg, eased through the on side for a single.

FOUR! That goes past the man there. 14 runs have come so far and all of them have been off boundaries. A quicker arm ball on off, Aiden Markram goes back and slashes this one through the backward point region.
SIX! That goes all the way! Just the second ball of Markram's innings and he dispatches this one. Flighted around off, Aiden Markram lofts this one with power over the long off region for a biggie.
Flighted around off, Markram pushes this one to mid off.
Mohammad Nawaz to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Nopes, he is not able to close the over off nicely. Around off, on a good length, Janneman Malan makes some room and just gently pushes this one through covers. A boundary. A good start though. Just 4 off the opening over.

Good bowling by Shaheen. Another short of a length ball on middle, JM looks to swing this one across the line but he fails to connect bat with ball this time again. 5 dots in a row. Can Shaheen Afridi finish the over and start with a maiden?
A shortish length ball on middle, Malan makes room but then does not offer a shot this time.
PLAY AND A MISS! A 143 kph delivery, which is a back of a length ball around off, Malan looks to slap this one through the point region but he fails to connect bat with ball on this occasion.
In the fuller zone around off, Malan only manages to work this one to the mid off region.
Around off, back of a length, Malan hops and pushes this one to the fielder at point.
We are all set to begin. The Pakistan players are out in the middle. Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram will open the innings for South Africa. Shaheen Afridi will start the proceedings for Pakistan.
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, George Linde, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen (WK/C), Wiaan Mulder (IN FOR PITE VAN BILJON), Andile Phehlukwayo, Sisanda Magala, Bjorn Fortuin (IN FOR BEURAN HENDRICKS), Lizaad Williams, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Both the captains are out in the middle. Pakistan win the toss and elect to bowl first!

Hello and welcome to the fourth and final T20I between South Africa and Pakistan in Centurion. The hosts would look to square the series as they are behind 2-1 in the series. They would want their bowlers to improve as they were smashed in the last match. On the other hand, Pakistan would look to win the series and they have a great opportunity to do the same here. Babar Azam played very well in the last match for his hundred. They would look to continue their winning momentum and finish the tour on a high. Stay tuned for the toss and the team news.
